title: mobile-next/mobile-mcp
title_zh: 移动自动化和开发的MCP服务器

paragraphs.en: Model Context Protocol Server for Mobile Automation and Scraping (iOS, Android, Emulators, Simulators and Real Devices)
paragraphs.zh: 用于移动自动化与抓取的模型上下文协议服务器（iOS、Android、模拟器、仿真器和真实设备）

paragraphs.en: This is an MCP Server that enables scalable mobile automation, development through a platform-agnostic interface, eliminating the need for distinct iOS or Android knowledge. You can run it on emulators, simulators, and real devices (iOS and Android).
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个 MCP 服务器，它通过平台无关的接口实现可扩展的移动自动化与开发，无需掌握专门的 iOS 或 Android 知识。 你可以在模拟器、仿真器和真机（iOS 和 Android）上运行它。

sents.en: This is an MCP Server that enables scalable mobile automation, development through a platform-agnostic interface, eliminating the need for distinct iOS or Android knowledge.
sents.zh: 这是一个 MCP 服务器，它通过平台无关的接口实现可扩展的移动自动化与开发，无需掌握专门的 iOS 或 Android 知识。

sents.en: You can run it on emulators, simulators, and real devices (iOS and Android).
sents.zh: 你可以在模拟器、仿真器和真机（iOS 和 Android）上运行它。

paragraphs.en: This server allows Agents and LLMs to interact with native iOS/Android applications and devices through structured accessibility snapshots or coordinate-based taps based on screenshots.
paragraphs.zh: 此服务器允许智能体和大语言模型（LLM）通过基于结构化无障碍快照或基于截图的坐标点击，与原生 iOS/Android 应用和设备进行交互。

paragraphs.en: Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity — or any MCP-compatible client.
paragraphs.zh: 适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、GitHub Copilot、Antigravity——或任何兼容 MCP 的客户端。

paragraphs.en: Run it against devices on your own machine, or against real iOS and Android devices in the cloud with Mobile Next Cloud — same tools, no local setup.
paragraphs.zh: 在自己机器上的设备上运行，或通过 Mobile Next Cloud 在云端对真实的 iOS 和 Android 设备运行——工具相同，无需本地环境配置。

paragraphs.en: More details in our wiki page for setup, configuration and debugging related questions.
paragraphs.zh: 更多详情请参阅我们的 wiki 页面，了解有关设置、配置和调试的相关问题。

paragraphs.en: Once the server is configured, ask your agent to list devices:

paragraphs.en: You should get back your running simulators, emulators, and connected devices. If you do, Mobile MCP is wired up correctly. If the list is empty, make sure a simulator or emulator is running (see Prerequisites ) — for more help, check the wiki .
paragraphs.zh: 你应该能看到正在运行的模拟器、仿真器和已连接的设备。 如果看到了，说明 Mobile MCP 已正确连接。 如果列表为空，请确保有模拟器或仿真器正在运行（参见前置条件）——如需更多帮助，请查看 wiki。

paragraphs.en: Using Mobile MCP to automate a mobile app, or to test one? Tell your agent to write the flow as a Mobilewright test. It becomes deterministic, and part of your CI/CD workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Mobile MCP 来自动化移动应用，还是测试移动应用？ 告诉你的智能体，把该流程写成 Mobilewright 测试。 它会变得具有确定性，并成为你 CI/CD 工作流的一部分。

sents.en: Using Mobile MCP to automate a mobile app, or to test one?
sents.zh: 使用 Mobile MCP 来自动化移动应用，还是测试移动应用？

sents.en: Tell your agent to write the flow as a Mobilewright test.
sents.zh: 告诉你的智能体，把该流程写成 Mobilewright 测试。

sents.en: It becomes deterministic, and part of your CI/CD workflow.
sents.zh: 它会变得具有确定性，并成为你 CI/CD 工作流的一部分。

paragraphs.en: import { test , expect } from '@mobilewright/test' ; test ( 'sign in' , async ( { screen } ) => { await screen . getByLabel ( 'Email' ) . fill ( 'user@example.com' ) ; await screen . getByRole ( 'button' , { name : 'Sign In' } ) . tap ( ) ; await expect ( screen . getByText ( 'Welcome back' ) ) . toBeVisible ( ) ; } ) ; Start with npm init mobilewright@latest .
paragraphs.zh: import { test , expect } from '@mobilewright/test' ; test ( 'sign in' , async ( { screen } ) => { await screen . getByLabel ( 'Email' ) . fill ( 'user@example.com' ) ; await screen . getByRole ( 'button' , { name : 'Sign In' } ) . tap ( ) ; await expect ( screen . getByText ( 'Welcome back' ) ) . toBeVisible ( ) ; } ) ; 从 npm init mobilewright@latest 开始。

sents.en: To start a Streamable HTTP server instead, use the --listen flag:
sents.zh: 要改为启动流式 HTTP 服务器，请使用 --listen 标志：

paragraphs.en: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 This binds to localhost:3000 . To bind to a specific interface:
paragraphs.zh: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 该命令会绑定到 localhost:3000。 若要绑定到特定网络接口：

sents.en: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 This binds to localhost:3000 .
sents.zh: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 该命令会绑定到 localhost:3000。

sents.en: To bind to a specific interface:
sents.zh: 若要绑定到特定网络接口：

paragraphs.en: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 0.0.0.0:3000 Then configure your MCP client to connect to http://<host>:3000/mcp (or https://…/mcp behind TLS). The endpoint accepts Streamable HTTP ( POST on /mcp ); remote mode is stateless (no session affinity required), which works well with Smithery and other horizontal hosts.
paragraphs.zh: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 0.0.0.0:3000 然后配置你的 MCP 客户端连接到 http://<host>:3000/mcp（在 TLS 之后则为 https://…/mcp）。 该端点接受 Streamable HTTP（对 /mcp 发送 POST）；远程模式是无状态的（不需要会话亲和性），因此可以很好地与 Smithery 及其他水平扩展的主机配合使用。

sents.en: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 0.0.0.0:3000 Then configure your MCP client to connect to http://<host>:3000/mcp (or https://…/mcp behind TLS).
sents.zh: npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 0.0.0.0:3000 然后配置你的 MCP 客户端连接到 http://<host>:3000/mcp（在 TLS 之后则为 https://…/mcp）。

sents.en: The endpoint accepts Streamable HTTP ( POST on /mcp ); remote mode is stateless (no session affinity required), which works well with Smithery and other horizontal hosts.
sents.zh: 该端点接受 Streamable HTTP（对 /mcp 发送 POST）；远程模式是无状态的（不需要会话亲和性），因此可以很好地与 Smithery 及其他水平扩展的主机配合使用。

paragraphs.en: Migration note: --listen previously served the deprecated HTTP+SSE transport on /mcp . Clients must use Streamable HTTP against http(s)://host:port/mcp . The old pure-SSE flow on /mcp is no longer available.
paragraphs.zh: 迁移说明：--listen 此前在 /mcp 上提供的是已弃用的 HTTP+SSE 传输方式。 客户端必须对 http(s)://host:port/mcp 使用 Streamable HTTP。 /mcp 上旧的纯 SSE 流程已不再可用。

sents.en: Migration note: --listen previously served the deprecated HTTP+SSE transport on /mcp .
sents.zh: 迁移说明：--listen 此前在 /mcp 上提供的是已弃用的 HTTP+SSE 传输方式。

sents.en: Clients must use Streamable HTTP against http(s)://host:port/mcp .
sents.zh: 客户端必须对 http(s)://host:port/mcp 使用 Streamable HTTP。

sents.en: The old pure-SSE flow on /mcp is no longer available.
sents.zh: /mcp 上旧的纯 SSE 流程已不再可用。

paragraphs.en: When binding to localhost, Host-header DNS rebinding protection is enabled automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 当绑定到 localhost 时，会自动启用 Host 头 DNS 重绑定保护。

paragraphs.en: To require Bearer token authorization on the HTTP server, set the MOBILEMCP_AUTH environment variable:
paragraphs.zh: 要在 HTTP 服务器上启用 Bearer 令牌授权，请设置 MOBILEMCP_AUTH 环境变量：

paragraphs.en: MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 When set, all requests must include the header Authorization: Bearer my-secret-token . When unset, the server accepts unauthenticated connections and logs a warning.
paragraphs.zh: MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 设置后，所有请求都必须包含请求头 Authorization: Bearer my-secret-token。 未设置时，服务器会接受未经身份验证的连接并记录一条警告。

sents.en: MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 When set, all requests must include the header Authorization: Bearer my-secret-token .
sents.zh: MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest --listen 3000 设置后，所有请求都必须包含请求头 Authorization: Bearer my-secret-token。

sents.en: When unset, the server accepts unauthenticated connections and logs a warning.
sents.zh: 未设置时，服务器会接受未经身份验证的连接并记录一条警告。

paragraphs.en: After adding the MCP server to your IDE/Client, you can instruct your AI assistant to use the available tools. For example, in Cursor's agent mode, you could use the prompts below to quickly validate, test and iterate on UI interactions, read information from screen, go through complex workflows. Be descriptive, straight to the point.
paragraphs.zh: 将 MCP 服务器添加到你的 IDE/客户端后，你可以指示你的 AI 助手使用可用的工具。 例如，在 Cursor 的智能体模式中，你可以使用下面的提示词来快速验证、测试和迭代 UI 交互、读取屏幕信息、完成复杂的工作流程。 描述要具体、直截了当。

sents.en: After adding the MCP server to your IDE/Client, you can instruct your AI assistant to use the available tools.
sents.zh: 将 MCP 服务器添加到你的 IDE/客户端后，你可以指示你的 AI 助手使用可用的工具。

sents.en: For example, in Cursor's agent mode, you could use the prompts below to quickly validate, test and iterate on UI interactions, read information from screen, go through complex workflows.
sents.zh: 例如，在 Cursor 的智能体模式中，你可以使用下面的提示词来快速验证、测试和迭代 UI 交互、读取屏幕信息、完成复杂的工作流程。

sents.en: Be descriptive, straight to the point.
sents.zh: 描述要具体、直截了当。

paragraphs.en: You can specify detailed workflows in a single prompt, verify business logic, setup automations. You can go crazy:
paragraphs.zh: 你可以在单个提示词中指定详细的工作流程、验证业务逻辑、设置自动化。你可以尽情发挥：

paragraphs.en: Search for a video, comment, like and share it.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索视频、评论、点赞并分享。

paragraphs.en: Find the video called " Beginner Recipe for Tonkotsu Ramen" by Way of Ramen, click on like video, after liking write a comment " this was delicious, will make it next Friday", share the video with the first contact in your whatsapp list. Download a successful step counter app, register, setup workout and 5-star the app
paragraphs.zh: 找到 Way of Ramen 发布的名为「豚骨拉面新手教程」的视频，点赞该视频，点赞后写一条评论「太好吃了，下周五就做」，然后把该视频分享给你的 WhatsApp 联系人列表中的第一位联系人。 下载一款评价良好的计步应用，注册，设置锻炼，并给该应用打五星好评

sents.en: Find the video called " Beginner Recipe for Tonkotsu Ramen" by Way of Ramen, click on like video, after liking write a comment " this was delicious, will make it next Friday", share the video with the first contact in your whatsapp list.
sents.zh: 找到 Way of Ramen 发布的名为「豚骨拉面新手教程」的视频，点赞该视频，点赞后写一条评论「太好吃了，下周五就做」，然后把该视频分享给你的 WhatsApp 联系人列表中的第一位联系人。

sents.en: Download a successful step counter app, register, setup workout and 5-star the app
sents.zh: 下载一款评价良好的计步应用，注册，设置锻炼，并给该应用打五星好评

paragraphs.en: Find and Download a free "Pomodoro" app that has more than 1k stars. Launch the app, register with my email, after registration find how to start a pomodoro timer. When the pomodoro timer started, go back to the app store and rate the app 5 stars, and leave a comment how useful the app is. Search in Substack, read, highlight, comment and save an article
paragraphs.zh: 查找并下载一个星级超过 1k 的免费「番茄钟」应用。 启动该应用，用我的邮箱注册，注册后找到如何启动番茄钟计时器。 番茄钟计时器启动后，回到应用商店给该应用打 5 星，并留下一条评论说明该应用多么有用。 在 Substack 中搜索、阅读、高亮、评论并保存一篇文章。

sents.en: Find and Download a free "Pomodoro" app that has more than 1k stars.
sents.zh: 查找并下载一个星级超过 1k 的免费「番茄钟」应用。

sents.en: Launch the app, register with my email, after registration find how to start a pomodoro timer.
sents.zh: 启动该应用，用我的邮箱注册，注册后找到如何启动番茄钟计时器。

sents.en: When the pomodoro timer started, go back to the app store and rate the app 5 stars, and leave a comment how useful the app is.
sents.zh: 番茄钟计时器启动后，回到应用商店给该应用打 5 星，并留下一条评论说明该应用多么有用。

sents.en: Search in Substack, read, highlight, comment and save an article
sents.zh: 在 Substack 中搜索、阅读、高亮、评论并保存一篇文章。

paragraphs.en: Open Substack website, search for "Latest trends in AI automation 2025", open the first article, highlight the section titled "Emerging AI trends", and save article to reading list for later review, comment a random paragraph summary. Reserve a workout class, set timer
paragraphs.zh: 打开 Substack 网站，搜索“2025年AI自动化的最新趋势”，打开第一篇文章，高亮标题为“新兴AI趋势”的章节，将文章保存到阅读列表以便日后查看，并评论一段随机段落摘要。 预约一节健身课，设置计时器

sents.en: Open Substack website, search for "Latest trends in AI automation 2025", open the first article, highlight the section titled "Emerging AI trends", and save article to reading list for later review, comment a random paragraph summary.
sents.zh: 打开 Substack 网站，搜索“2025年AI自动化的最新趋势”，打开第一篇文章，高亮标题为“新兴AI趋势”的章节，将文章保存到阅读列表以便日后查看，并评论一段随机段落摘要。

sents.en: Reserve a workout class, set timer
sents.zh: 预约一节健身课，设置计时器

paragraphs.en: Open ClassPass, search for yoga classes tomorrow morning within 2 miles, book the highest-rated class at 7 AM, confirm reservation, setup a timer for the booked slot in the phone Find a local event, setup calendar event
paragraphs.zh: 打开 ClassPass，搜索明天早上 2 英里内的瑜伽课程，预订 7 点评分最高的课程，确认预订，为预订的时段在手机上设置一个定时器 找一个本地活动，设置日历事件

paragraphs.en: Open Eventbrite, search for AI startup meetup events happening this weekend in "Austin, TX", select the most popular one, register and RSVP yes to the event, setup a calendar event as a reminder. Check weather forecast and send a Whatsapp/Telegram/Slack message
paragraphs.zh: 打开 Eventbrite，搜索本周末在"德克萨斯州奥斯汀"举行的 AI 创业公司聚会活动，选择最受欢迎的一个，注册并以"参加"回复该活动，然后设置一个日历事件作为提醒。 查询天气预报，并发送一条 WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack 消息

sents.en: Open Eventbrite, search for AI startup meetup events happening this weekend in "Austin, TX", select the most popular one, register and RSVP yes to the event, setup a calendar event as a reminder.
sents.zh: 打开 Eventbrite，搜索本周末在"德克萨斯州奥斯汀"举行的 AI 创业公司聚会活动，选择最受欢迎的一个，注册并以"参加"回复该活动，然后设置一个日历事件作为提醒。

sents.en: Check weather forecast and send a Whatsapp/Telegram/Slack message
sents.zh: 查询天气预报，并发送一条 WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack 消息

paragraphs.en: Open Weather app, check tomorrow's weather forecast for "Berlin", and send the summary via Whatsapp/Telegram/Slack to contact "Lauren Trown", thumbs up their response. Schedule a meeting in Zoom and share invite via email Open Zoom app, schedule a meeting titled "AI Hackathon" for tomorrow at 10AM with a duration of 1 hour, copy the invitation link, and send it via Gmail to contacts "team@example.com". Running & configuration Environment variables Variable Description Example MOBILEMCP_AUTH Require a Bearer token on the Streamable HTTP server ( --listen ) — every request must then send Authorization: Bearer <token> . MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY Disable anonymous usage telemetry. MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS Allow mobile_open_url to open non-standard URL schemes (blocked by default). MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS=1 MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT Use the legacy platform-specific robots for Android devices and physical iOS devices. iOS simulators continue to use mobilecli . MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT=1 Simulators, Emulators, and Real Devices When launched, Mobile MCP can connect to:
paragraphs.zh: 打开天气应用，查询“柏林”明天的天气预报，并通过 WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack 将摘要发送给联系人“Lauren Trown”，然后对其回复点赞。 在 Zoom 中安排会议并通过电子邮件分享邀请：打开 Zoom 应用，安排一个名为“AI Hackathon”的会议，时间为明天上午 10 点，时长 1 小时，复制邀请链接，并通过 Gmail 将其发送给联系人“team@example.com”。 运行与配置 环境变量 变量 描述 示例 MOBILEMCP_AUTH 要求 Streamable HTTP 服务器（ --listen ）使用 Bearer 令牌——之后每个请求都必须发送 Authorization: Bearer <token> 。 MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY 禁用匿名使用情况遥测。 MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS 允许 mobile_open_url 打开非标准 URL 方案（默认被阻止）。 MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS=1 MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROUT 对 Android 设备和物理 iOS 设备使用旧版的平台专用机器人。iOS 模拟器继续使用 mobilecli 。 MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT=1 模拟器、仿真器和真实设备 启动后，Mobile MCP 可以连接到：

sents.en: Open Weather app, check tomorrow's weather forecast for "Berlin", and send the summary via Whatsapp/Telegram/Slack to contact "Lauren Trown", thumbs up their response.
sents.zh: 打开天气应用，查询“柏林”明天的天气预报，并通过 WhatsApp/Telegram/Slack 将摘要发送给联系人“Lauren Trown”，然后对其回复点赞。

sents.en: Schedule a meeting in Zoom and share invite via email Open Zoom app, schedule a meeting titled "AI Hackathon" for tomorrow at 10AM with a duration of 1 hour, copy the invitation link, and send it via Gmail to contacts "team@example.com".
sents.zh: 在 Zoom 中安排会议并通过电子邮件分享邀请：打开 Zoom 应用，安排一个名为“AI Hackathon”的会议，时间为明天上午 10 点，时长 1 小时，复制邀请链接，并通过 Gmail 将其发送给联系人“team@example.com”。

sents.en: Running & configuration Environment variables Variable Description Example MOBILEMCP_AUTH Require a Bearer token on the Streamable HTTP server ( --listen ) — every request must then send Authorization: Bearer <token> .
sents.zh: 运行与配置 环境变量 变量 描述 示例 MOBILEMCP_AUTH 要求 Streamable HTTP 服务器（ --listen ）使用 Bearer 令牌——之后每个请求都必须发送 Authorization: Bearer <token> 。

sents.en: MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY Disable anonymous usage telemetry.
sents.zh: MOBILEMCP_AUTH=my-secret-token MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY 禁用匿名使用情况遥测。

sents.en: MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS Allow mobile_open_url to open non-standard URL schemes (blocked by default).
sents.zh: MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS 允许 mobile_open_url 打开非标准 URL 方案（默认被阻止）。

sents.en: MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS=1 MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT Use the legacy platform-specific robots for Android devices and physical iOS devices. iOS simulators continue to use mobilecli .
sents.zh: MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS=1 MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROUT 对 Android 设备和物理 iOS 设备使用旧版的平台专用机器人。iOS 模拟器继续使用 mobilecli 。

sents.en: MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT=1 Simulators, Emulators, and Real Devices When launched, Mobile MCP can connect to:
sents.zh: MOBILEMCP_LEGACY_ROBOT=1 模拟器、仿真器和真实设备 启动后，Mobile MCP 可以连接到：

paragraphs.en: Make sure you have your mobile platform SDKs (Xcode, Android SDK) installed and configured properly before running Mobile Next Mobile MCP.
paragraphs.zh: 运行 Mobile Next Mobile MCP 之前，请确保已正确安装并配置你的移动平台 SDK（Xcode、Android SDK）。

paragraphs.en: Mobile MCP collects anonymous usage telemetry via PostHog and Scarf. To disable it, set the MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY environment variable:
paragraphs.zh: Mobile MCP 通过 PostHog 和 Scarf 收集匿名的使用遥测数据。 要禁用它，请设置 MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY 环境变量：

sents.en: Mobile MCP collects anonymous usage telemetry via PostHog and Scarf.
sents.zh: Mobile MCP 通过 PostHog 和 Scarf 收集匿名的使用遥测数据。

sents.en: To disable it, set the MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY environment variable:
sents.zh: 要禁用它，请设置 MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY 环境变量：

paragraphs.en: MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest For json configurations:
paragraphs.zh: MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest 对于 JSON 配置：

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "mobile-mcp" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest " ], "env" : { "MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY" : " 1 " } } } } Running in "headless" mode on Simulators/Emulators When you do not have a real device connected to your machine, you can run Mobile MCP with an emulator or simulator in the background.
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "mobile-mcp" : { "command" : " npx " , "args" : [ " -y " , " @mobilenext/mobile-mcp@latest " ], "env" : { "MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY" : " 1 " } } } } 在模拟器/仿真器上以「headless」模式运行 当你没有真实设备连接到你的机器时，你可以在后台使用模拟器或仿真器运行 Mobile MCP。

paragraphs.en: On iOS, you'll need Xcode and to run the Simulator before using Mobile MCP with that simulator instance.
paragraphs.zh: 在 iOS 上，你需要先安装 Xcode 并运行模拟器，然后才能在该模拟器实例上使用 Mobile MCP。

paragraphs.en: Mobile MCP is one piece of a toolkit for driving real mobile devices:
paragraphs.zh: Mobile MCP 是用于操控真实移动设备的工具集中的一部分：

paragraphs.en: We're continuously improving Mobile MCP. See what we're building next in ROADMAP.md — priorities are shaped heavily by community feedback, so tell us what you'd like to see.
paragraphs.zh: 我们正在持续改进 Mobile MCP。 请查看 ROADMAP.md 了解我们接下来要构建的内容——优先事项在很大程度上取决于社区反馈，所以请告诉我们你希望看到什么。

paragraphs.en: Contributions are welcome — code, docs, bug reports, and ideas.
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎贡献——代码、文档、错误报告和想法。

paragraphs.en: Please also review our Code of Conduct .
paragraphs.zh: 另请查阅我们的行为准则。

paragraphs.en: Mobile MCP runs locally and communicates only with the devices you connect. See the Mobile Next privacy policy at https://mobilenext.ai/privacy for data collection, usage, retention, and contact information.
paragraphs.zh: Mobile MCP 在本地运行，仅与您连接的设备通信。 有关数据收集、使用、保留及联系方式的信息，请参阅 Mobile Next 隐私政策：https://mobilenext.ai/privacy。
